For each group L, stably sort its indices by field text in ASCII lexicographic order; LF maps each old index to its sorted position. For each LF cycle collect L values, reverse them, and take the lexicographically least cyclic rotation. Sort these cycles in descending lexicographic order and concatenate. Join all fields with ASCII spaces; print only.
